title: mime-tree: InlineUUBlock and InlineYEncBlock missing Hash derive
description:
Why this exists: mime_tree/src/uuencode.rs defines InlineUUBlock and mime_tree/src/yenc.rs defines InlineYEncBlock. Both derive PartialEq and Eq but not Hash.

What goes wrong: a type that implements Eq but not Hash cannot be used as a HashMap/HashSet key (the standard library's HashMap requires K: Eq + Hash). Because inline UU/yEnc blocks are identified by their content (begin offset, filename, etc.), deduplication or caching by block identity requires Hash. Without it, callers who try to deduplicate blocks via HashSet<InlineUUBlock> will get a compile error. The standard approach is to derive all three together: PartialEq, Eq, Hash.

Fix: add Hash to the derive lists for InlineUUBlock and InlineYEncBlock.
